Name: Bushes And Shrubs
Author: hmkiesel
Description:
This mod introduces 4 plantable shrubs:
[list]
[*]Large Shrub - a manicured evergreen shrub
[*]Small Shrub - a smaller variety of the Large Shrub
[*]Daphne Bush - a flowering bush with small white flowers
[*]Hydrangea Bush - a flowering bush with large clusters of bright pink, blue, and purple flowers
[/list]
More varieties to come in future versions!

Starters can be purchased from Pierre and grow in all seasons. In winter, they will be topped with snow :)

All bushes produce starters every 10 days which can be sold or replanted.

Chinese translation courtesy of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/119451898]kiwipart[/url]!

All other translations are added by me using Google translate so likely will not be accurate. If something doesn't look right in your language, please leave a comment and I can fix it!
